resources.string: Base URL of the Immich server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283
Needs the album.read, asset.read and asset.view permissions
At most this many pictures from each album. 0 means no limit.
Show this percentage of each album\'s pictures, then apply the max above. 0 means all of them.
Seconds each picture stays on screen
Names of the albums to show, separated by commas. Use * for any characters, e.g. portalgo-*. Leave empty for every album.
Names of the albums to leave out, separated by commas, with * as above. Checked after the list above, so it wins.
Only albums holding pictures from this year onwards (or up to it). 0 means no limit. Albums the server gives no dates for are left out when either year is set.
Tap the screen, then the settings button, to set the Immich server URL and API key.
Can\'t reach the MQTT broker at %1$s:%2$d\n%3$s
No answer from the MQTT broker at %1$s:%2$d\nSomething is listening there, but it isn\'t answering as a broker. Check the port.

Not connecting to the MQTT broker: the topic prefix %1$s belongs to another device (%2$s)\nGive this device its own prefix in the MQTT tab, or, if that device is gone, clear its record with mosquitto_pub -r -n -t %3$s
Connected to the MQTT broker, but can\'t subscribe to its commands\n%1$s
Received audio announce request but couldn\'t fetch \"%1$s\"\n%2$s
Received audio announce request but couldn\'t play \"%1$s\"\n%2$s
%1$s\n\nRetrying soon. Tap the screen for settings.
To grant everything at once, connect the device to a computer with adb and run tools/setup-device.sh from the AstroDock sources. Items below with a button can also be set up here.
Not the home screen: Home opens the Portal\'s own launcher
Not the screensaver: the Portal shows its own when idle
Missing power permission: the screen can\'t be turned off at night
Missing system settings permission: the screensaver delay can\'t be changed
Missing secure settings permission: the screen off delay and high contrast text can\'t be changed
Missing overlay permission: no home button over apps like WhatsApp
Missing notification access: no media controls on the slideshow
Missing install permission: the Apps tab can\'t install or update apps
Show the slideshow instead of the Portal home screen.
Show the slideshow when the Portal is idle. Pick AstroDock in the list that opens.
Lets the app switch the screen off itself, for the night hours in the Slideshow tab. On a Portal the system\'s dialog refuses it, so only adb can grant it there.
AstroDock uses this only to turn the screen off.
Lets the app change how long the Portal waits before starting the screensaver.

Lets the app keep the screen off delay at what the Slideshow tab says; the Portal resets it otherwise. Only adb can allow this:\n\nadb shell pm grant com.nicobrailo.astrodock android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Outlines text everywhere on the Portal, so it can\'t disappear into its background. The Portal\'s theme paints the install dialog\'s text the same colour as the page behind it, which makes installing anything, or updating AstroDock, look like a blank white screen. Needs the adb grant above.
Drop an app on another app to put them in a folder.

Lets the slideshow show and control what other apps are playing, e.g. Jellyfin. Turn AstroDock on in the list that opens. On a Portal that list closes again as it appears, so only adb can grant it there.
Pages and apps pinned to the home screen (such as Firefox\'s \"Add to Home screen\"), one tap away on the slideshow and the screensaver. The app list always shows them.
Current temperature and sky over the clock, from Open-Meteo. Refreshed on the hour.
A town or city, e.g. Amsterdam. If several share the name, add a comma and the region or country: Springfield, Illinois. Somewhere with no name works as coordinates: 52.37, 4.89.
Couldn\'t look up %1$s just now. The slideshow will try again.

Minutes after the Portal last saw someone in the room before the screen switches off. 0 leaves it to the Portal, which is the steadier choice: its own delay is about 20 minutes, and shorter ones make the screen blink off while somebody is in the room. Needs the screen off delay in the System tab.
Turn the screen off at night

Keeps the screen dark during the hours below: switched off, or black and dimmed while the Portal keeps waking it because someone is in the room. A touch brings the pictures back for a few minutes. Needs \"Turn the screen off\" in the System tab.
Not available: AstroDock has no permission to turn the screen off. Grant \"Turn the screen off\" in the System tab, or on a Portal, run tools/setup-device.sh.
Showing the home button over this app
Show a home button over this app
Don\'t show a home button over this app
Lets the launcher draw a home button over apps that hide the Portal\'s own Back and Home buttons, like WhatsApp. Pick the apps by long-pressing them in the app list.
First allow AstroDock to install apps, then try again.
Lets AstroDock install the apps offered in the Apps tab. The system still asks before each install.
Reports what this device is doing: whether someone is around, whether the slideshow is running, and which picture is on screen.
Host name or IP of the MQTT broker, e.g. 10.0.0.10
Leave empty if the broker needs no login

Everything is published under this prefix. A trailing / is added if missing. Empty means this device\'s Bluetooth name, which is the name it was given at setup. Give each device its own prefix, or they overwrite each other.
How this device identifies itself to the broker. Empty means this device\'s Bluetooth name.
Plays the sound files the broker sends with announce_audio. When off, they are ignored.
